extracted.intended_audience: web developers and site maintainers configuring MathJax accessibility features (a11y), accessibility engineers, content authors embedding mathematics
extracted.subtask_description: Configure MathJax v4 accessibility-related extensions (semantic-enrich, speech, complexity, explorer, assistive-mml) and their options to control enrichment, speech/Braille output, collapsibility, exploration UI, and related developer hooks. Includes guidance about when to use the contextual menu versus direct option settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context menu controls accessibility extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Because the accessibility extensions are controlled by the settings of the MathJax contextual menu, when the ui/menu is loaded, you use the Contextual Menu Options to determine whether they are enabled or not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are settings below that can be used to disable the extensions in case they are loaded automatically, but these are not the settings that control whether the extensions themselves are loaded. That is controlled by the menu settings. If you are not using a combined component, you can load the extensions explicitly using the Loader Options, but it is probably better to use the menu options above so that if a user turns the extensions off, they will not incur the network and startup costs of loading the extensions they will not be using.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic-Enrich extension presence and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: This extension coordinates the creation and embedding of semantic information generated by the enrichment process within the MathJax output for use by the other extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds an enrich action to the document’s default renderActions object; required for complexity computations and speech and Braille generation — disabling enrichment effectively disables nearly all the accessibility tools at once.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableEnrichment
rubrics_metrics.description: true // false to disable enrichment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls whether semantic enrichment is applied to the internal MathML representation when the semantic-enrich extension is loaded. Controlled automatically by the context menu when present; use menu settings in that case. If no menu, use this option to disable enrichment if the component was loaded automatically and you don't need it.

rubrics_metrics.name: enrichError
rubrics_metrics.description: (doc, math, err) => doc.enrichError(doc, math, err) // function to call if enrichment fails
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Called when semantic enrichment fails. Default calls MathDocument.enrichError() which prints a warning in the browser console and uses the original (unenriched) MathML. You can override to record the error or replace MathML with alternative error content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speech extension presence and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: This extension coordinates the generation of speech strings and Braille notation that are added to the HTML or SVG nodes for screen readers or the a11y/explorer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds an attachSpeech action to the document’s default renderActions object. Speech generation is separated from enrichment in v4 (speech handled by speech extension). Configure SRE and worker options for detailed control.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableSpeech
rubrics_metrics.description: true // false to disable speech strings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls whether speech strings are generated and attached to DOM elements when the speech extension is loaded. Controlled by context menu when present; if no menu, use this option to disable speech generation if you don't need it.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableBraille
rubrics_metrics.description: true // false to disable Braille notation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls whether Braille labels are generated and attached to DOM elements when the speech extension is loaded. Controlled by context menu when present; if no menu, use this option to disable Braille generation if you don't need it.

rubrics_metrics.name: speechError
rubrics_metrics.description: (doc, math, err) => doc.speechError(doc, math, err) // called if speech generation fails
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default calls MathDocument.speechError() which prints a warning in the browser console. You can override to record or handle errors differently.

rubrics_metrics.name: sre (Speech-Rule Engine) configuration block
rubrics_metrics.description: sre: { domain: 'mathspeak', style: 'default', locale: 'en' } // speech rules domain, style, language
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets SRE configuration for speech and Braille. See SRE documentation for details; controls rules domain (e.g., 'mathspeak'), style, and locale.

rubrics_metrics.name: a11y duplication of speech/braille
rubrics_metrics.description: a11y: { speech: true, braille: true } // duplicate boolean values
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These boolean values essentially duplicate enableSpeech and enableBraille; present in the configuration for convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: speech worker configuration
rubrics_metrics.description: worker: { path: 'path-to-bundle/a11y/sre', maps: 'path-to-sre/lib/mathmaps', worker: 'speech-worker.js', debug: false }
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parameters control speech generation via webworkers to avoid blocking the page. Usually you should not need to change these. 'debug: true' will include debugging messages in console about communications between page and workers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complexity extension presence and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: This extension generates a complexity metric and inserts elements that allow the expressions to be collapsed by the user by clicking on the expression based on that metric.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds a complexity action to the document’s default renderActions object. Complexity is used to determine collapsibility and produce condensed speech strings.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableComplexity
rubrics_metrics.description: true // set to false to disable complexity computations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls whether the complexity extension runs when loaded. Controlled automatically by the context menu when present; use menu settings in that case. If no menu, use this option to disable computations if you don't need them.

rubrics_metrics.name: makeCollapsible
rubrics_metrics.description: true // insert mactions to allow collapsing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines whether the extension will insert <maction> elements to allow complex expressions to be collapsed so they take up less space and produce condensed speech strings. When false, expressions are not altered, but elements are marked internally if they would be collapsible.

rubrics_metrics.name: identifyCollapsible (developer option)
rubrics_metrics.description: true // determines whether complexity numbers should take collapsing into account
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, parents of collapsible elements will get complexity values reflecting the collapsible elements being collapsed. If false, complexities assume no collapsing will take place.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collapse (developer hook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collapse // the Collapse object class to use for creating the <maction> elements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows creation of a subclass of Collapse and passing that to the document for custom behavior of collapsing elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplexityVisitor (developer hook)
rubrics_metrics.description: ComplexityVisitor // object class to use for managing computations of complexity values
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows providing a subclass of ComplexityVisitor to the document to customize complexity computation logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explorer extension presence and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: This extension provides support for interactive exploration of expressions within the page (see Accessibility Features).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds an explorable action to the document’s default renderActions object. Enables interactive exploration features like speech, Braille, subtitles, highlighting, magnification, and semantic info explorers.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableExplorer
rubrics_metrics.description: true // set to false to disable the explorer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls whether the explorer extension runs when loaded. Value controlled automatically by context menu when present; otherwise use this option to disable the explorer if it was loaded automatically and is not needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableExplorerHelp
rubrics_metrics.description: true // set to false to disable the help icon and dialog
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls display of the small 'info' help icon and the 'press h for help' message. Setting to false prevents the icon and help dialog and will make assistive users unable to obtain help — do not set false if pages may be viewed by users with accessibility needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: explorer a11y: speech
rubrics_metrics.description: speech: true // Determines whether speech output is produced
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default, speech is computed for every expression on the page and will be voiced by a screen reader when the page is read or when the explorer is started.

rubrics_metrics.name: explorer a11y: braille
rubrics_metrics.description: braille: true // Determines whether Braille output is produced
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default, Braille is computed for every expression and will be sent to a Braille output device when the page is read or explorer started.

rubrics_metrics.name: subtitles
rubrics_metrics.description: subtitles: true // show speech as a subtitle
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether the speech string for the selected sub-expression will be shown as a subtitle under the expression during exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: viewBraille
rubrics_metrics.description: viewBraille: false // display Braille output as subtitles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether Braille output will be displayed under the expression as it is explored.

rubrics_metrics.name: help (explorer option)
rubrics_metrics.description: help: true // include 'press h for help' messages on focus
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether the explorer should voice 'press h for help' when an expression becomes focused. Helps new users discover help but experienced users may disable it.

rubrics_metrics.name: roleDescription
rubrics_metrics.description: roleDescription: 'math' // the role description to use for math expressions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what description should be voiced by screen readers when reading a MathJax expression. Value can be set via the contextual menu to options including no description.

rubrics_metrics.name: voicing
rubrics_metrics.description: voicing: false // switch on speech output using Browser voice API
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines whether MathJax will read expressions using the Browser’s voice API during expression exploration; useful for users not using a screen reader but wanting spoken output.

rubrics_metrics.name: backgroundColor
rubrics_metrics.description: backgroundColor: 'Blue' // color for background of selected sub-expression
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Color choices: 'Blue', 'Red', 'Green', 'Yellow', 'Cyan', 'Magenta', 'White', 'Black'. Used for background of selected sub-expression during exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: backgroundOpacity
rubrics_metrics.description: backgroundOpacity: .2 // opacity for background (1 opaque, 0 transparent)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates opacity for the background color of the selected sub-expression; 1 is fully opaque, 0 is fully transparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: foregroundColor
rubrics_metrics.description: foregroundColor: 'Black' // color to use for text of selected sub-expression
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choice of foreground colors same as for backgroundColor; used for text of selected sub-expression during exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: foregroundOpacity
rubrics_metrics.description: foregroundOpacity: 1 // opacity for text (1 opaque, 0 transparent)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates opacity to use for text of the selected sub-expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: highlight
rubrics_metrics.description: highlight: 'None' // type of highlighting for collapsible sub-expressions ('None','Flame','Hover')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chooses a particular highlighter for showing collapsible sub-expressions; options include 'None', 'Flame', and 'Hover'.

rubrics_metrics.name: flame
rubrics_metrics.description: flame: false // switch on the Flame highlighter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When true, permanently highlights collapsible sub-expressions with successively darkening background for nested collapsible expressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: hover
rubrics_metrics.description: hover: false // switch on the Hover highlighter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When true, highlights collapsible sub-expressions when hovering with the mouse pointer. Note: having both 'hover' and 'flame' true can lead to unexpected side-effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: treeColoring
rubrics_metrics.description: treeColoring: false // enable tree coloring
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables tree coloring to visually distinguish expressions by giving neighbouring symbols different contrasting foreground colors.

rubrics_metrics.name: magnification (magnifier type)
rubrics_metrics.description: magnification: 'None' // choices: 'None','Keyboard','Mouse'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies a particular magnifier for enlarging sub-expressions during exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: magnify (magnification factor)
rubrics_metrics.description: magnify: '400%' // percent to use for zoomed sub-expression
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the magnification factor for zoomed sub-expressions; default is 400%.

rubrics_metrics.name: keyMagnifier
rubrics_metrics.description: keyMagnifier: false // switch on zooming via keyboard exploration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables zooming of sub-expressions during keyboard exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: mouseMagnifier
rubrics_metrics.description: mouseMagnifier: false // switch on zooming via mouse hovering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables zooming of sub-expressions by hovering with the mouse pointer. Note: using both keyMagnifier and mouseMagnifier together can lead to unwanted side-effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: align (placement of magnified expression)
rubrics_metrics.description: align: 'top' // placement of magnified expression
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies where to place the zoomed version of the selected sub-expression when displayed during exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic Info explorers: infoType
rubrics_metrics.description: infoType: false // activates an explorer that investigates semantic type of sub-expressions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The semantic type is an immutable property of an expression, independent of its position; types may vary by subject area of a document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic Info explorers: infoRole
rubrics_metrics.description: infoRole: false // activates an explorer to present the semantic role of a sub-expression
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Semantic role is dependent on the sub-expression's context in the overall expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic Info explorers: infoPrefix
rubrics_metrics.description: infoPrefix: false // activates explorer for prefix information (e.g., 'exponent','radicand')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefix information pertains to the position of a sub-expression and would be announced during interactive exploration with speech output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning about multiple mouse-based exploration tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: switching on multiple mouse-based exploration tools can lead to unexpected interactions and often unpredictable side effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While multiple keyboard-based exploration techniques work well together, avoid enabling many mouse-based tools simultaneously to prevent tool interaction issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assisitve-MML extension presence and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: This extension adds visually hidden MathML to MathJax’s output that can be voiced by some screen readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds an action to the document’s default renderActions object that does the MathML insertion. In v4, assistive-mml is not active by default whereas other accessibility tools are included and enabled by default.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableAssistiveMml
rubrics_metrics.description: false // controls whether the assistive-mml extension is to run
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controlled by context menu when present; when menu is not available, use this option to disable assistive MathML if the assistive-mml component was loaded automatically and is not needed. Note: users who prefer assistive MathML can turn off semantic enrichment (disables other tools) and turn on assistive MathML via the contextual menu.
